name: Chicken coop
description: A small plank hen house on four legs, about 1.5 × 1.2 × 1.6 m: board walls with a hinged egg door and a slatted window on the front, a pop hole with a slide shutter and a cleated ramp down to the ground at one end, and a steep thatched gable roof with a rope-bound ridge.

provenance.prompt: A small plank hen house on legs with a ramp and a thatched roof, about 1.5 × 1.2 × 1.6 m.
